title: Cliff Jackson's 1926 record and the oldest records they have
summary: Cliff's 1926 piano roll and 78 of 'The Entertainer'; the oldest recording of Maxine is on the tape.

blocks.x: Going back to some of the stuff we
S. & S. REPORTING COMPANY, INC. WOrth 2-2915 WOrth 2-2943
were talking about before off tape, you're saying that (Cliff) made a (piano roll) in 1926.
"The Hock Shop Blues," yeah, I picked that up --
Didn't you do the "The Entertainer" you said.
Yes, I have a 78 that Cliff made in 1926 with "The Entertainer" on there.
Is that the oldest record of his you've got, '26?
I'm not trying to be comical, what's the oldest record you have of yourself?
The oldest record I have of myself is on that tape.
